title: "Extension Not Loading: Claude Code Missing from VS Code"
body:
**Bug Description**
  Issue: Claude Code VS Code extension not appearing in VS Code despite being installed

  Environment:
  - OS: CachyOS (Arch-based Linux)
  - Platform: Linux 6.15.1-5-cachyos
  - VS Code: 
```
Version: 1.100.3
Commit: 258e40fedc6cb8edf399a463ce3a9d32e7e1f6f3
Date: 2025-06-02T13:30:54.273Z
Electron: 34.5.1
ElectronBuildId: 11369351
Chromium: 132.0.6834.210
Node.js: 20.19.0
V8: 13.2.152.41-electron.0
OS: Linux x64 6.15.1-5-cachyos
```
  - Claude Code extension: v1.0.17 (installed at ~/.vscode/extensions/anthropic.claude-code-1.0.17)

  Problem:
  - Extension files exist in the correct directory but VS Code doesn't recognize it
  - Extension doesn't appear in:
    - Extensions panel (@installed view)
    - Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P)
    - Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+K Ctrl+S)
  - No Claude Code commands are available
  - Ctrl+Esc shortcut conflicts with system performance app

  Steps taken:
  1. Confirmed extension files exist at ~/.vscode/extensions/anthropic.claude-code-1.0.17
  2. Attempted to find extension in VS Code UI
  3. Searched command palette and keyboard shortcuts

  Expected behavior:
  Extension should be visible in VS Code and Claude Code commands should be accessible via command palette and keyboard shortcuts.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 1.0.17
- Feedback ID: eaff8a65-96fc-4102-a089-f01cc4820ee9

top_comments.body:
Thanks for the report. 
How did you install the extension? Was it auto-installed by claude code or did you install it manually?

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body:
Does it work if you run 'claude' in the terminal?  (doe the diffs show up in vscode?)
What version of the extension do you see in the extension list?

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body:
@tlockney - what happens if you go to the app store and install Claude Code for VSCode extension?  Are you doing local dev or remote?
@apetta - sounds like a setting turned off the button and the actions. I'd try un-installing and re-installing CC extension from VSCode marketplace and failing that look through your user and global settings in VS Code
